verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; Google spend is delivering zero results.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 130 leads at an average cost of $19.85 per lead — all of them from Meta, while Google Ads consumed $1,240 with no recorded conversions. This past week was notably softer: leads fell 50% and cost per lead rose 29% compared to the prior week, driven by a sharp pullback in Google spending and a late-week stall in Meta volume. We are addressing the Google Ads issue directly — budget is being reallocated away from underperforming campaigns and conversion tracking improvements are on the roadmap for September. New landing pages and a fresh creative batch are both scheduled for delivery by August 31, which should support a stabilization in Meta lead flow heading into September.

average cost per lead over the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: 130 leads entered the pipeline this period but none have progressed to appointments or a won opportunity, pointing to a gap in intake or follow-up.
watch_item.fix: The CRM build covering all identified pipeline gaps is targeted for completion by August 31, with a full end-to-end stack re-test scheduled at the same time.
